description: Server-side module for handling invoice detail display and actions in a SvelteKit application. Includes load function to fetch invoice data, company info, contacts, accounts, and templates, as well as actions for updating, canceling, sending, marking paid, and downloading invoice PDFs.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches invoice details, related accounts, contacts, organization settings, and templates; transforms data for frontend use.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles updating invoice data with form input, including CRM relationships and line items.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels the invoice via API and redirects to invoice list.

methods.name: markPaid
methods.description: Marks the invoice as paid with specified amount and payment details.

methods.name: downloadPdf
methods.description: Fetches invoice PDF from backend Django API, using JWT token, encodes it base64 for frontend download.
